Theorem
[Perelman---no local collapsing] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0400 1. appD:D.36\group No Local Collapsing

For a Ricci flow $g(t)$ on a closed manifold with finite maximal time $T$ and every $\rho >0$, there is $\kappa =\kappa (g(0),T,\rho )>0$ such that $g(t)$ is $\kappa $-noncollapsed below scale $\rho $ for every $t<T$.
